interpretation: W18 computes finite one-loop BSM two-point insertions for every W17 case and applies them target-blindly to the SMDR projection. It is complete for the registered new-sector two-point channels, but not a two-loop or fully on-shell BSM renormalization calculation.

scheme.renormalization: MSbar finite two-point insertion with zero-momentum mass-parameter subtraction

implemented_channels: singlet zero-momentum self-energy from vector-like Yukawa
